title: fix(i18n): translate the SSO set-password page (zh)
body:
The post-SSO 'Set a recovery password' page (shown right after entering a cloud-provisioned env) rendered in English in an otherwise-Chinese product. The page already used `auth.setPassword.*` keys; the zh bundle just lacked values, so it fell back to English defaults. Adds the zh `setPassword` block. Browser-verified.
